refnamediv.refpurpose: Update the current session id with a newly generated one

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.errors;
Throws an Error if the session cannot be opened, if a new session ID cannot be created (also when it collides with an existing one in strict mode), or if the new session cannot be read.

&reftitle.seealso;
